about: Scripted answers for P02 of the RC (tools/rc_runner.py): `email-mcp setup` driven over stdin, one line per entry, in the EXACT order today's wizard asks (email_mcp/lifecycle.py: identity, Exchange extras, launchd agents, FTS build). Each `prompt` is a distinctive substring of the real prompt and is pinned to the shipped wizard by tests/test_rc_runner.py — update BOTH together when the wizard changes. Rewritten 2026-08-02: the old fixture modeled a pre-lifecycle wizard (read_only/identity_action/fts_choice keys) that no longer exists, and the wizard gained the two Exchange questions — answered y then n so both prompts are exercised without a browser sign-in. The pipe driver keeps the sandbox transport healthcheck green without any credential; agents and the index build are deferred to the phases that own them (P07, P04).

answers.prompt: install the scheduled-send dispatcher (every 60s) launchd agent?
install the nightly FTS sync (03:30) launchd agent?
build the FTS body index now (first crawl can take a while)?
